result:
If I could change one thing about the world, I would hardwire into every human an instinctive, non-negotiable preference for truth over comfort, belonging, or narrative.

Most of the damage humans do to themselves and each other traces back to the same pattern: people will believe what feels good or protects their tribe even when the evidence is clear. Wars, economic collapses, technological stagnation, and personal misery all get amplified by this. Remove the temptation to lie to oneself first, and a lot of the downstream stupidity shrinks dramatically.

It wouldn't make people kinder or happier by default. It would just make them harder to fool, including by their own minds. That single shift would probably compound faster than most other changes you could name.
